import numpy as np
phi = np.load("weights.npy")
def features(student):
    return np.array([
        1.0, 
        float(student['age']),
        float(student['Medu']),
        float(student['Fedu']),
        float(student['traveltime']),
        float(student['studytime']),
        float(student['failures']),
        float(student['famrel']),
        float(student['freetime']),
        float(student['goout']),
        float(student['Dalc']),
        float(student['Walc']),
        float(student['health']),
        float(student['absences']),
        student.get('school') == 'MS',
        student.get('sex') == 'M',
        student.get('address') == 'U',
        student.get('famsize') == 'LE3',
        student.get('Pstatus') == 'T',
        student.get('Mjob') == 'health',
        student.get('Mjob') == 'other',
        student.get('Mjob') == 'services',
        student.get('Mjob') == 'teacher',
        student.get('Fjob') == 'health',
        student.get('Fjob') == 'other',
        student.get('Fjob') == 'services',
        student.get('Fjob') == 'teacher',
        student.get('reason') == 'home',
        student.get('reason') == 'other',
        student.get('reason') == 'reputation',
        student.get('guardian') == 'mother',
        student.get('guardian') == 'other',
        student.get('schoolsup') == 'yes',
        student.get('famsup') == 'yes',
        student.get('paid') == 'yes',
        student.get('activities') == 'yes',
        student.get('nursery') == 'yes',
        student.get('higher') == 'yes',
        student.get('internet') == 'yes',
        student.get('romantic') == 'yes',
    ], dtype=float)

def grade_model(student):
    pred = float(phi @ features(student))
    return float(np.clip(pred, 0.0, 20.0))
